observations.finding: The supplied coordinate summaries concern predicted endpoint forecasts in world-coordinate A, rather than current atom states. The observed window contains 50 generation nodes t=0.00 through 0.49 within [0,0.5]; terminal score time is 0.99 and terminal state time is 1.0. Regional moments average children within extant parent and score stratum, then average batches equally; 14 generation batches provide independent uncertainty units.

Whole-window high-minus-low selection contrasts associate selection with lower shape_xx (-0.495 z, CI [-0.648,-0.320], q=0.000813; negative in 13/14 batches) and shape_yy (-0.513, CI [-0.620,-0.424], q=0.0000149; negative in 14/14). Pair kernels 1.5, 2.5 and 3.5 are higher (+0.562,+0.631,+0.540; positive in 14/14), whereas kernel 7.0 is lower (-0.485; negative in 14/14). This resolves a multiscale geometric association; these related summaries are not independent motifs or evidence of atom-type interactions.

Landmark 00 has convergent selection associations: softmin -0.481 z (CI [-0.650,-0.320], q=0.000813), occupancy3 +0.545 (CI [0.393,0.699], q=0.000235), and soft_mass +0.639 (CI [0.492,0.791], q=0.000188), each with the same direction in all 14 batches. Local cxx/cyy are lower (-0.579/-0.575), and local_dy is lower (-0.301; 13/14 negative). This supports a candidate regional pattern, without establishing information beyond correlated global shape or identifying a residue.

Regional contrasts are spatially heterogeneous: local_dy is positive at regions 02/06/18 (+0.405/+0.425/+0.425 z; 14/14 positive) but negative at 03/12/16 (-0.483/-0.529/-0.498; 14/14 negative). Local cxy is positive at 03/11/13 (+0.365/+0.370/+0.304; q=0.0437/0.0379/0.0497), with weaker batch agreement (11/14,11/14,10/14). Position and covariance therefore deserve joint consideration, but the compact moments do not recover distinct complete conformations.

Exact-node regional contrasts change substantially across the full window. Landmark_00_soft_mass starts at -0.366 z, peaks at +1.641 at t=0.16, and ends at -0.275 at t=0.49. Landmark_00_local_cxx reaches -1.636 at t=0.24 but ends at -0.088; local_cyy reaches -1.336 at t=0.24 and ends at +0.253. Local_dy at 02/06/18 peaks near +1.20/+1.27/+1.29 at t=0.20 and ends at -0.315/-0.334/-0.341. Integrated enrichment is not a fixed sign at every supported node.

Sparse salient-field matching and full fixed-frame matching choose different teachers under leave-one-batch exclusion: top4 overlap is 0.470 (batch-bootstrap CI [0.427,0.515]); compressed-choice excess fixed RMS is 0.081 A (CI [0.070,0.092]). Compressed chosen-teacher proper-rigid RMS remains 0.529 A, versus fixed RMS 0.564 A. Sparse matching incurs full-geometry discrepancies, and proper rigid alignment does not eliminate the compressed chosen teacher discrepancy; this audit neither resolves modes nor tests the complete reward or its gradient.

Later survival weakly echoes immediate selection at landmark 00: soft_mass +0.365 z (CI [0.200,0.515], q=0.1204, 12/14 positive), local_cxx -0.324 (q=0.3019), and local_cyy -0.252 (q=0.3019). Coverage limits interpretation: 349/700 batch-nodes (49.9%) have fewer than 3 ancestors and 531/700 (75.9%) fewer than 6; terminal teachers number 17-28 per node, with at most 2 per batch. This is exploratory survival credit, not corrected evidence of final affinity benefit.

Incumbent program_20 has the largest reported mean_pic50_delta among the 22 discovery records (+0.230299), valid-rate change +0.01, and MMFF relief median/p90 0.476946/0.954550. Program_3 is almost tied in mean (+0.229293) but has p90 1.252575. Program_4 has the largest best_valid_pic50 (8.558043) but valid-rate change -0.02 and median/p90 0.500959/1.012100. Program_19 has lower mean (+0.212839), p90 0.907866, and greater window shape improvement (0.212913 versus 0.173587). Program_8 has lower relief median/p90 0.461815/0.731024 but lower mean (+0.139001). These reused adaptive discovery records establish tradeoffs, not an independently validated optimum.

hypotheses: For the requested paired generation comparison, retain registered program_20 unchanged as the evidence-supported candidate: endpoint_pointcloud with the registered endpoint reference and existing scalar values. Its discovery mean is competitive while its supplied relief tail is better than the near-tied program_3. This is a conservative comparison choice, not proof that its architecture or native_rms_ratio=0.33 is optimal (quality:program_20; quality:program_3; information_audit). Evaluate final predicted affinity and strain on all attempts and failures, separating means from physical tails.

Preserving complete endpoint geometry may retain selection-relevant conformation information discarded by salient moments; the information audit supports testing this hypothesis, while its teacher-score correlations do not establish affinity causality. Retain alternative geometric modes only if future evidence resolves them rather than inventing mode centers from compact moments (information_audit; regional_curves).

Landmark-00 enrichment together with lower local spread is a candidate localization hypothesis. Its benefit remains conditional on incremental information beyond global shape and overlapping regions, cross-batch reproducibility, and independent final-quality validation; the observed node sign changes preclude treating the integrated direction as uniform throughout the window (endpoint_effects:14; endpoint_effects:15; regional_effects:0; regional_effects:4; regional_effects:5; regional_curves).

Defer a hypothesis that terminal-credit geometry improves final affinity: survival directions are suggestive but none survives the joint BH correction, ancestral coverage is sparse, and the terminal-reference quality records show different validity and relief tradeoffs. Additional independent evidence is needed before preferring terminal teachers or assigning repeated descendants extra credit (lineage_support; survival_effects:0; quality:program_4; quality:program_6; quality:program_11).

counterevidence.finding: All 24 audited fitted Legendre curves have legendre_runtime_allowed=false. Relative node RMSE ranges from 0.386 to 0.931, above the supplied <=0.35 rule; some also show strong sign conflicts. For example, shape_yy ends empirically at +0.163 z while its fit is -0.513, and landmark_06_softmin ends at -0.402 versus fitted +0.294. A significant integrated contrast does not validate the fitted curve at runtime.

Only landmark_00_softmin among the 74 supplied increment tests passes q<0.05 (-4.914, CI [-6.855,-2.616], q=0.0461); occupancy3, pair_kernel_2.5 and shape_yy have q=0.0811/0.2082/0.1606. Regional landmark-00 change-rate effects for soft_mass/cxx/cyy do not pass the supplied correction (q=0.817/0.909/0.742), whereas parent-edge cxx/cyy contrasts pass (q=0.0289/0.0358). Level enrichment, change in enrichment and parent-edge contrast are distinct estimands; none is physical atom velocity.

No supplied survival test has q<0.05 across the 400 jointly corrected field/measure tests; the minimum q is 0.12043. Pointwise CIs excluding zero and agreeing signs remain insufficient after correction. This correction concerns survival, not terminal affinity, and repeated descendants cannot supply independent replication.

Lower local x/y covariance appears across many overlapping regions as well as global shape. Similar signs at regions 00,07,16,19 do not demonstrate an additional localized effect beyond common shape. Regional landmarks lack atom types and residue mechanism evidence.

Global x/z translation and global xy/xz covariance have q>0.21, so a universal translation or covariance direction is unsupported. Several occupancy3 effects are statistically corrected but extremely small (-0.00196 at region 01, -0.00684 at 03, -0.00472 at 05); statistical significance alone does not warrant reward weight or establish a physical effect.

Sparse teacher-score correlation (0.102) exceeds full matching correlation (0.064); the geometric information advantage is not an observed affinity-prediction advantage. Discovery mean, best-valid affinity, valid rate and relief tails rank programs differently, and all quality records explicitly describe adaptive reused batches. Neither the largest mean nor the best molecule establishes affinity improvement with strain non-regression.

limitations: Analysis uses only the bound evidence.json and literal request; no trajectories, program implementations, other experimental conditions, external material, generation calls or source edits were used. The response chooses a registered candidate for comparison without executing it.

Selection associations are observational and conditional on the supplied populations. Endpoint forecasts, immediate score-stratum preference, eventual survival and final predicted quality are different quantities; missing future labels are missing, not affinity failures.

The supplied summaries do not expose full atom configurations, atom types, landmark residue identities, conditional/global-adjusted effects or feature correlation matrices. Joint modes and independent regional contributions cannot be recovered or chemical interactions and energies inferred from these proxies.

Times are generation clocks, not physical time. Observed exact nodes end at 0.49; neither interpolation nor evidence at t=0.50 or later is established. The execution contract permits exact learned nodes with native continuation, zero extra production forward calls, endpoint VJP, no affinity-head gradient, no SMC and no graph veto.

Independent uncertainty comes from 14 batches and specified parent-debiased moments; clone multiplicity, many features and 50 nodes are not additional independent samples. Future lineage coverage is sparse, and survival correction does not correct terminal-affinity hypotheses.

Discovery records omit paired validation uncertainty, attempt/failure counts, physical-tail denominators, a stated material strain-regression margin, and complete definitions/units for the relief fields. They cannot establish all-attempt non-regression or a scalar dose optimum. Program_20 retention is provisional pending the requested independent paired comparison.
